hooks.description: Validate Tauri JS/TS code before writing
hooks.command: echo 'Validating Tauri JS code...' && claude-code agent tauri-js-validator --input '{content}' --prompt 'Validate this Tauri JavaScript/TypeScript code for correctness according to the cheat sheets'

hooks.description: Validate Tauri Rust code before writing
hooks.command: echo 'Validating Tauri Rust code...' && claude-code agent tauri-rust-validator --input '{content}' --prompt 'Validate this Tauri Rust code for correctness according to the cheat sheet'

hooks.description: Check for cheat sheet updates after Rust compilation errors
hooks.condition: command contains 'cargo' AND exitCode != 0 AND stderr contains 'error'
hooks.command: echo 'Analyzing Rust compilation error for documentation gaps...' && claude-code agent cheatsheet-updater --prompt 'Rust compilation error occurred. Command: {command}. Error: {stderr}. Check if cheat sheets need updating to prevent this error.'

hooks.description: Check for cheat sheet updates after Tauri dev/build errors
hooks.condition: command contains 'tauri dev' OR command contains 'tauri build' AND exitCode != 0
hooks.command: echo 'Analyzing Tauri error for documentation gaps...' && claude-code agent cheatsheet-updater --prompt 'Tauri error occurred. Command: {command}. Error: {stderr}. Check if cheat sheets need updating to prevent this error.'

hooks.description: Check for cheat sheet updates after npm/yarn errors in Tauri projects
hooks.condition: (command contains 'npm' OR command contains 'yarn') AND exitCode != 0 AND stderr contains 'tauri'
hooks.command: echo 'Analyzing npm/yarn Tauri error for documentation gaps...' && claude-code agent cheatsheet-updater --prompt 'Frontend build error in Tauri project. Command: {command}. Error: {stderr}. Check if cheat sheets need updating.'
